name: shell-topbar-dense
description: Top navigation + context row + one dense work area. No footer.
provenPattern: Shell matrix — chrome × body: 5 chromes × 4 bodies = 20, four eliminated (with no chrome a grid has no way out, a dense surface has no interaction, a split refutes itself) → 16 cells.

knowledge.purpose: The frame of a tool with few areas: navigation on top, the rest of the screen belongs to the data
antiPatterns: Adding a footer — there is nothing to read under a dense work area
Skipping the context row — it is the only place the user learns where they are
More than five top-level areas — then navigation belongs in a left rail

mobileCollapse: The top bar collapses into a drawer; links are listed in one column. The context row collapses into the heading; tables turn into card rows instead of scrolling horizontally.

placeholders.{{MAIN}}: main slot — the bands and weaves of the page sit here, in reading order
placeholders.{{LEGAL}}: copyright / legal line — PLAIN TEXT, one line (e.g. "© 2026 Acme Ltd."). The ONLY place the copyright appears: the `footer` band carries link columns and never a copyright. Leave it empty ("") for none
